stages.event: 0–6s. Start at the revised same-moment opening. Keen runs along the clear stepping route PAST Zenny’s leaf without touching her, the leaf or its support. He reaches the far-tree hanging comb and lifts the WHOLE honeycomb. Zenny remains seated and undisturbed on her original leaf with the small residual forehead mark. Fuzzby alone loses his perch; his wings immediately lift him into a stable drone-like hover. He fixes his gaze on Keen and accelerates after him. Keep Fuzzby at canonical small scale.
stages.end_state: Keen holds the whole comb; branch empty. Fuzzby airborne in pursuit. Zenny still seated and untouched on her leaf.

stages.event: 6–10s. Fuzzby flies straight toward Keen with rapid continuous wing motion and a focused drone-like pursuit. Keen glances back at the approaching Fuzzby for his recorded Uh-oh at 8s, turns and runs back along the established crossing route with the honeycomb. He passes clear of Zenny again. Camera follows their movement without changing their real sizes or moving the banks.
stages.end_state: Keen back beside near-bank machine with the comb. Fuzzby arrives nearby; Zenny stays at far leaf.

stages.event: 10–15s. Keen reaches his original EMPTY catapult while looking back at Fuzzby. In a readable side view, his short tail catches against the exposed throwing arm as he passes too close. That contact tips the loose support and releases the empty arm against his tail at the recorded Ow at 12s. Show one cause and one contact. His recoil releases the whole comb; it bounces once and rolls to Fuzzby on the near bank. The mechanism contains no berry, wool ball or projectile at any moment.
stages.end_state: Whole comb stops at Fuzzby; Keen paws empty. Machine wobbles; original branch empty; cup empty.

stages.event: 15–22.21s. Let Fuzzby notice the unexpected prize and look to Keen. Medium Fuzzby for Nice machine at 18s; reverse to Keen for It almost worked at 20s. Keen tries a trace of dignity, then deflates. AFTER his reply the loosened machine collapses with one wooden clatter.
stages.end_state: Fuzzby beside comb, Keen beside collapsed empty machine. All action ends before the final button.

stages.event: 22.21s–end. Cut to a SETTLED close-up of Zenny on her original leaf, purple mark remaining. Meet camera with both eyes open, close ONE eye for a clear knowing wink while the other stays open, reopen it; then close both eyes and hold peaceful meditation to the end. Camera is still before the wink; no extra joke.
stages.end_state: Zenny meditates on her original leaf with eyes closed and purple mark. Near bank: Keen and collapsed machine, Fuzzby with whole comb. No new action.

Fuzzby pursues by continuous wing-driven drone-like flight, not by becoming bear-sized or running.
